State the governing relation for a uniform wire: $R = \rho L / A$.
Substitute the values with units: $R = (2.30 \times 10^{-8} \text{ } \Omega \text{ m})(2.50 \times 10^{-3} \text{ m}) / (6.25 \times 10^{-8} \text{ m}^2)$.
